prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic studio photograph of a generic adult male athlete mid-air as if running or jumping, wearing a pastel pink sweatshirt and light pink jogger pants, with soft blue sneakers. Pink powder smoke is exploding and swirling around his body, especially behind him and around his legs, creating a dynamic motion effect. Clean minimal background with a soft gradient from light gray to pale pink. Cinematic lighting, ultra-sharp focus, shallow depth of field, fashion advertising style, high detail, 8k, soft shadows, professional studio photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated limbs, muddy powder edges
